1.mohsin_khan: Ta-Sin-Mim. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings.]

2.sahih_international: These are the verses of the clear Book.
2.pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
2.yusuf_ali: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
2.shakir: These are the verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
2.muhammad_sarwar: These are the verses of the illustrious Book.
2.mohsin_khan: These are the Verses of the manifest Book [this Quran, which was promised by Allah in the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), makes things clear].
2.arberry: Those are the signs of the Manifest Book.

3.sahih_international: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
3.pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
3.yusuf_ali: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
3.shakir: Perhaps you will kill yourself with grief because they do not believe.
3.muhammad_sarwar: You will perhaps kill yourself with anguish because they are not accepting the faith.
3.mohsin_khan: It may be that you (O Muhammad SAW) are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers [in your Risalah (Messengership) and in your Message of Islamic Monotheism].
3.arberry: Perchance thou consumest thyself that they are not believers.

4.sahih_international: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
4.pickthall: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
4.yusuf_ali: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
4.shakir: If We please, We should send down upon them a sign from the heaven so that their necks should stoop to it.
4.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted, We would have sent them a miracle from the sky to make their heads hang down in submission.
4.mohsin_khan: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
4.arberry: If We will, We shall send down on them out of heaven a sign, so their necks will stay humbled to it.

5.sahih_international: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
5.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
5.yusuf_ali: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
5.shakir: And there does not come to them a new reminder from the Beneficent Allah but they turn aside from it.
5.muhammad_sarwar: Whenever a new message comes to them from the Beneficent God, they turn away from it.
5.mohsin_khan: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Beneficent (Allah), but they turn away therefrom.
5.arberry: But never fresh remembrance comes to them from the All-merciful, except they turn away from it.

6.sahih_international: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
6.pickthall: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
6.yusuf_ali: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
6.shakir: So they have indeed rejected (the truth), therefore the news of that which they mock shall soon come to them.
6.muhammad_sarwar: They have called (our revelation) lies. They will soon learn the consequences of what they mocked.
6.mohsin_khan: So they have indeed denied (the truth - this Quran), then the news of what they mocked at, will come to them.
6.arberry: So they have cried lies; therefore assuredly tidings will come to them of that they mocked at.

7.sahih_international: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
7.pickthall: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
7.yusuf_ali: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
7.shakir: Do they not see the earth, how many of every noble kind We have caused to grow in it?
7.muhammad_sarwar: Have they not seen the earth in which We have made gracious plants grow?
7.mohsin_khan: Do they not observe the earth, how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein?
7.arberry: What, have they not regarded the earth, how many therein We have caused to grow of every generous kind?

8.sahih_international: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
8.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
8.yusuf_ali: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
8.shakir: Most surely there is a sign in that, but most of them will not believe.
8.muhammad_sarwar: In this there is, certainly, evidence (of the Truth). But most of them have no faith.
8.mohsin_khan: Verily, in this is an Ayah (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans, etc., who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.
8.arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

9.sahih_international: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
9.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
9.yusuf_ali: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
9.shakir: And most surely your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
9.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord is the Majestic and the All-merciful.
9.mohsin_khan: And verily, your Lord! He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
9.arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

10.sahih_international: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
10.pickthall: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
10.yusuf_ali: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
10.shakir: And when your Lord called out to Musa, saying: Go to the unjust people,
10.muhammad_sarwar: When Your Lord told Moses to go to the unjust people of the Pharaoh
10.mohsin_khan: And (remember) when your Lord called Musa (Moses) (saying): "Go to the people who are Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doing),
10.arberry: And when thy Lord called to Moses, 'Go to the people of the evildoers,

11.sahih_international: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
11.pickthall: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
11.yusuf_ali: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah?"
11.shakir: The people of Firon: Will they not guard (against evil)?
11.muhammad_sarwar: and ask them, "Why do you not fear God?"
11.mohsin_khan: The people of Fir'aun (Pharaoh). Will they not fear Allah and become righteous?"
11.arberry: the people of Pharaoh; will they not be godfearing?'

12.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
12.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
12.yusuf_ali: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
12.shakir: He said: O my Lord! surely I fear that they will reject me;
12.muhammad_sarwar: He replied, "Lord, I am afraid that they will call me a liar.
12.mohsin_khan: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will belie me,
12.arberry: He said, 'My Lord, I fear they will cry me lies,

13.sahih_international: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
13.pickthall: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
13.yusuf_ali: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
13.shakir: And by breast straitens, and my tongue is not eloquent, therefore send Thou to Haroun (to help me);
13.muhammad_sarwar: I feel nervous and my tongue is not fluent, so send Aaron with me.
13.mohsin_khan: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Harun (Aaron) (to come along with me).
13.arberry: and my breast will be straitened, and my tongue will not be loosed; so send to Aaron.

14.sahih_international: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
14.pickthall: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
14.yusuf_ali: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
14.shakir: And they have a crime against me, therefore I fear that they may slay me.
14.muhammad_sarwar: They have charged me [with a crime] for which I am afraid they will kill me."
14.mohsin_khan: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me."
14.arberry: They also have a sin against me, and I fear they will slay me.'

15.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
15.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
15.yusuf_ali: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
15.shakir: He said: By no means, so go you both with Our signs; surely We are with you, hearing;
15.muhammad_sarwar: The Lord said, "Have no fear, both of you go with Our miracles. We shall closely listen to you."
15.mohsin_khan: Allah said: "Nay! Go you both with Our Signs. Verily! We shall be with you, listening.
15.arberry: Said He, 'No indeed; but go, both of you, with Our signs, and We assuredly shall be with you, listening.

16.sahih_international: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
16.pickthall: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
16.yusuf_ali: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
16.shakir: Then come to Firon and say: Surely we are the apostles of the Lord of the worlds:
16.muhammad_sarwar: They came to the Pharaoh and said, "We are the Messengerss of the Lord of the Universe.
16.mohsin_khan: "And when you both come to Fir'aun (Pharaoh), say: 'We are the Messengers of the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists),
16.arberry: So go you to Pharaoh, and say, "Verily, I am the Messenger of the Lord of all Being;

17.sahih_international: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
17.pickthall: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
17.yusuf_ali: "'Send thou with us the Children of Israel.'"
17.shakir: Then send with us the children of Israel.
17.mohsin_khan: "So allow the Children of Israel to go with us.' "
17.arberry: so send forth with us the Children of Israel."

18.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
18.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
18.yusuf_ali: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life?
18.shakir: (Firon) said: Did we not bring you up as a child among us, and you tarried among us for (many) years of your life?
18.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh said, "Did we not bring you up in our home as an infant and did you not live with us for many years
18.mohsin_khan: [Fir'aun (Pharaoh)] said [to Musa (Moses)]: "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you did dwell many years of your life with us.
18.arberry: He said, 'Did we not raise thee amongst us as a child? Didst thou not tarry among us years of thy life?

19.sahih_international: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
19.pickthall: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
19.yusuf_ali: "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
19.shakir: And you did (that) deed of yours which you did, and you are one of the ungrateful.
19.muhammad_sarwar: and you did the deed which you did. You are certainly ungrateful."
19.mohsin_khan: "And you did your deed, which you did (i.e. the crime of killing a man). And you are one of the ingrates."
19.arberry: And thou didst the deed thou didst, being one of the ungrateful!'

20.sahih_international: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
20.pickthall: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
20.yusuf_ali: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
20.shakir: He said: I did it then while I was of those unable to see the right course;
20.muhammad_sarwar: Moses said, "I did do it and I made a mistake.
20.mohsin_khan: Musa (Moses) said: "I did it then, when I was an ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).
20.arberry: Said he, 'Indeed I did it then, being one of those that stray;

21.sahih_international: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
21.pickthall: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
21.yusuf_ali: "So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers.
21.shakir: So I fled from you when I feared you, then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me of the apostles;
21.muhammad_sarwar: Then I ran away from you in fear, but my Lord granted me the law and has appointed me as a Messenger.
21.mohsin_khan: "So I fled from you when I feared you. But my Lord has granted me Hukman (i.e. religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood), and appointed me as one of the Messengers.
21.arberry: so I fled from you, fearing you. But my Lord gave me Judgment and made me one of the Envoys.

22.sahih_international: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
22.pickthall: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
22.yusuf_ali: "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
22.shakir: And is it a favor of which you remind me that you have enslaved the children of Israel?
22.muhammad_sarwar: And this is the favor with which you oblige me: You have made the Israelites your slaves.
22.mohsin_khan: "And this is the past favour with which you reproach me, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."
22.arberry: That is a blessing thou reproachest me with, having enslaved the Children of Israel.'

23.sahih_international: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
23.pickthall: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
23.yusuf_ali: Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds'?"
23.shakir: Firon said: And what is the Lord of the worlds?
23.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh asked, "Who is the Lord of the Universe?"
23.mohsin_khan: Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said: "And what is the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists)?"
23.arberry: Pharaoh said, 'And what is the Lord of all Being?'

24.sahih_international: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
24.pickthall: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
24.yusuf_ali: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure."
24.shakir: He said: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you would be sure.
24.muhammad_sarwar: Moses replied, "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you want to be certain".
24.mohsin_khan: Musa (Moses) said: "Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty."
24.arberry: He said, 'The Lord of the heavens and earth, and what between them is, if you have faith.'

25.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
25.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
25.yusuf_ali: (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)?"
25.shakir: (Firon) said to those around him: Do you not hear?
25.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh said to the people around him, "Did you hear that?"
25.mohsin_khan: Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)?"
25.arberry: Said he to those about him, 'Do you not hear?'

26.sahih_international: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
26.pickthall: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
26.yusuf_ali: (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning!"
26.shakir: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of old.
26.muhammad_sarwar: Moses continued, "He is the Lord and the Lord of your forefathers."
26.mohsin_khan: Musa (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers!"
26.arberry: He said, 'Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers, the ancients.'

27.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
27.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
27.yusuf_ali: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman!"
27.shakir: Said he: Most surely your Apostle who is sent to you is mad.
27.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh said, "The Messengers who has been sent to you is certainly insane".
27.mohsin_khan: Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!"
27.arberry: Said he, 'Surely your Messenger who was sent to you is possessed!'

28.sahih_international: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
28.pickthall: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
28.yusuf_ali: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense!"
28.shakir: He said: The Lord of the east and the west and what is between them, if you understand.
28.muhammad_sarwar: Moses continued, "He is the Lord of the East and West and all that is between them, if only you would think".
28.mohsin_khan: Musa (Moses) said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand!"
28.arberry: He said, 'The Lord of the East and West, and what between them is, if you have understanding,'

29.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
29.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
29.yusuf_ali: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison!"
29.shakir: Said he: If you will take a god besides me, I will most certainly make you one of the imprisoned.
29.muhammad_sarwar: Pharaoh said, "If you put forward any god other than me, I will surely put you in prison".
29.mohsin_khan: Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said: "If you choose an ilah (god) other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners."
29.arberry: Said he, 'If thou takest a god other than me, I shall surely make thee one of the imprisoned.'

30.sahih_international: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
30.pickthall: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
30.yusuf_ali: (Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing?"
30.shakir: He said: What! even if I bring to you something manifest?
30.muhammad_sarwar: Moses asked, "What if I were to bring you clear proof (of the existence of God)?"
30.mohsin_khan: Musa (Moses) said: "Even if I bring you something manifest (and convincing)?"
30.arberry: He said, 'What, even though I brought thee something so manifest?'

31.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
31.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
31.yusuf_ali: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth!"
31.shakir: Said he: Bring it then, if you are of the truthful ones.
31.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh replied, "Bring it, if you are telling the truth."
31.mohsin_khan: Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful!"
31.arberry: Said he, 'Bring it then, if thou art of the truthful.'

32.sahih_international: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
32.pickthall: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
32.yusuf_ali: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)!

32.mohsin_khan: So [Musa (Moses)] threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest.
32.arberry: So he cast his staff, and behold, it was a serpent manifest.

33.sahih_international: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
33.pickthall: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
33.yusuf_ali: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
33.shakir: And he drew forth his hand, and lo! it appeared white to the onlookers.
33.muhammad_sarwar: Then he uncovered his hand and it was sheer white to the onlookers.
33.mohsin_khan: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
33.arberry: And he drew forth his hand, and lo, it was white to the beholders.

34.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
34.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
34.yusuf_ali: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed:
34.shakir: (Firon) said to the chiefs around him: Most surely this is a skillful magician,
34.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh said to the people around him, "He is certainly a skillful magician.
34.mohsin_khan: [Fir'aun (Pharaoh)] said to the chiefs around him: "Verily! This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer.
34.arberry: Said he to the Council about him, 'Surely this man is a cunning sorcerer

35.pickthall: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?
35.yusuf_ali: "His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel?"
35.shakir: Who desires to turn you out of your land with his magic; what is it then that you advise?
35.muhammad_sarwar: He wants to expel you from your land through his magic. What is your opinion?"
35.mohsin_khan: "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery, then what is it your counsel, and what do you command?"
35.arberry: who desires to expel you from your land by his sorcery; what do you command?'

36.pickthall: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
36.yusuf_ali: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect-
36.shakir: They said: Give him and his brother respite and send heralds into the cities
36.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "Hold him and his brother off for a while
36.mohsin_khan: They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities
36.arberry: They said, 'Put him and his brother off a while, and send among the cities musterers,

37.sahih_international: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
37.pickthall: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.
37.yusuf_ali: "And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed."
37.shakir: That they should bring to you every skillful magician.

37.mohsin_khan: "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."
37.arberry: to bring thee every cunning sorcerer.

38.pickthall: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
38.yusuf_ali: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
38.shakir: So the magicians were gathered together at the appointed time on the fixed day,
38.muhammad_sarwar: So all the magicians gathered together
38.mohsin_khan: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.
38.arberry: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a fixed day.

39.sahih_international: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
39.pickthall: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
39.yusuf_ali: And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled?-
39.shakir: And it was said to the people: Will you gather together?
39.mohsin_khan: And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble?
39.arberry: The people were asked, 'Will you assemble?

40.sahih_international: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
40.pickthall: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
40.yusuf_ali: "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"
40.shakir: Haply we may follow the magicians, if they are the vanquishers.
40.muhammad_sarwar: and the people were asked, "Will you all be there so that we may follow the magicians if they become victorious?"

49.sahih_international: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
49.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
49.yusuf_ali: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross!"

49.arberry: Said Pharaoh, 'You have believed him before I gave you leave. Why, he is the chief of you, the same that taught you sorcery; now you shall know! I shall assuredly cut off alternately your hands and feet, then I shall crucify you all together.'

187.mohsin_khan: "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"
187.arberry: Then drop down on us lumps from heaven, if thou art one of the truthful.'

188.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
188.pickthall: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
188.yusuf_ali: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."
188.shakir: He said: My Lord knows best what you do.
188.muhammad_sarwar: He said, "My Lord knows all that you do."
188.mohsin_khan: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."
188.arberry: He said, 'My Lord knows very well what you are doing.'

189.sahih_international: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
189.pickthall: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
189.yusuf_ali: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.
189.shakir: But they called him a liar, so the punishment of the day of covering overtook them; surely it was the punishment of a grievous day.
189.muhammad_sarwar: They rejected him and then the torment of the gloomy day struck them. It was certainly a great torment.
189.mohsin_khan: But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them, indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.
189.arberry: But they cried him lies; then there seized them the chastisement of the Day of Shadow; assuredly it was the chastisement of a dreadful day.

190.sahih_international: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
190.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
190.yusuf_ali: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
190.shakir: Most surely there is a sign in this, but most of them do not believe.
190.muhammad_sarwar: In this there is an evidence of the Truth, but many of them did not have any faith.
190.mohsin_khan: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
190.arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

191.sahih_international: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
191.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
191.yusuf_ali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
191.shakir: And most surely your Lord is Mighty, the Merciful.
191.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord is Majestic and All-merciful.
191.mohsin_khan: And verily! Your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
191.arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.

192.sahih_international: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
192.pickthall: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
192.yusuf_ali: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
192.shakir: And most surely this is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
192.muhammad_sarwar: This, (Quran), is certainly the revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
192.mohsin_khan: And truly, this (the Quran) is a revelation from the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists),
192.arberry: Truly it is the revelation of the Lord of all Being,

193.sahih_international: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
193.pickthall: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
193.yusuf_ali: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
193.shakir: The Faithful Spirit has descended with it,
193.muhammad_sarwar: It has been revealed through the trustworthy Spirit
193.mohsin_khan: Which the trustworthy Ruh [Jibrael (Gabriel)] has brought down;
193.arberry: brought down by the Faithful Spirit

194.sahih_international: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
194.pickthall: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
194.yusuf_ali: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
194.shakir: Upon your heart that you may be of the warners
194.muhammad_sarwar: to your heart, so that you will warn (the people of the dangers of disobeying God).
194.mohsin_khan: Upon your heart (O Muhammad SAW) that you may be (one) of the warners,
194.arberry: upon thy heart, that thou mayest be one of the warners,

195.muhammad_sarwar: It has been revealed in plain Arabic.

196.sahih_international: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
196.pickthall: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
196.yusuf_ali: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
196.shakir: And most surely the same is in the scriptures of the ancients.
196.muhammad_sarwar: Its news was also mentioned in the ancient Books.
196.mohsin_khan: And verily, it (the Quran, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad SAW) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurat (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.
196.arberry: Truly it is in the Scriptures of the ancients.

197.sahih_international: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
197.pickthall: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
197.yusuf_ali: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
197.shakir: Is it not a sign to them that the learned men of the Israelites know it?
197.muhammad_sarwar: Is not the fact (that the Israelite scholars already knew about the Quran through their Book) sufficient evidence for the pagans of the truthfulness (of the Quran)?
197.mohsin_khan: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like 'Abdullah bin Salam who embraced Islam) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
197.arberry: Was it not a sign for them, that it is known to the learned of the Children of Israel?

198.sahih_international: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
198.pickthall: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
198.yusuf_ali: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
198.shakir: And if we had revealed it to any of the foreigners
198.muhammad_sarwar: Had We revealed it to a non-Arab
198.mohsin_khan: And if We had revealed it (this Quran) unto any of the non-Arabs,
198.arberry: If We had sent it down on a barbarian

199.sahih_international: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
199.pickthall: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
199.yusuf_ali: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
199.shakir: So that he should have recited it to them, they would not have believed therein.
199.muhammad_sarwar: who would have read it to them, they (pagans) would not have believed in it.
199.mohsin_khan: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
199.arberry: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.

200.sahih_international: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
200.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
200.yusuf_ali: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
200.shakir: Thus have We caused it to enter into the hearts of the guilty.
200.muhammad_sarwar: Thus it passes through the hearts of the criminals.
200.mohsin_khan: Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Quran) to enter the hearts of the Mujrimun (criminals, polytheists, sinners, etc.).
200.arberry: Even so We have caused it to enter into the hearts of the sinners,

201.sahih_international: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
201.pickthall: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
201.yusuf_ali: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
201.shakir: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
201.muhammad_sarwar: They will not believe in it until they suffer the painful torment.
201.mohsin_khan: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment;
201.arberry: who will not believe in it, until they see the painful chastisement

202.sahih_international: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
202.pickthall: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
202.yusuf_ali: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
202.shakir: And it shall come to them all of a sudden, while they shall not perceive;
202.muhammad_sarwar: The torment will strike them suddenly without their knowledge.
202.mohsin_khan: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
202.arberry: so that it will come upon them suddenly, while they are not aware,

203.sahih_international: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
203.pickthall: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
203.yusuf_ali: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
203.shakir: Then they will say: Shall we be respited?
203.muhammad_sarwar: They will say, "Can we be granted any respite?"
203.mohsin_khan: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"
203.arberry: and they will say, 'Shall we be respited?'

204.sahih_international: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
204.pickthall: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
204.yusuf_ali: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
204.shakir: What! do they still seek to hasten on Our punishment?
204.muhammad_sarwar: Do they want to hasten Our torment?
204.mohsin_khan: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?
204.arberry: What, do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

205.sahih_international: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
205.pickthall: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
205.yusuf_ali: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
205.shakir: Have you then considered if We let them enjoy themselves for years,
205.muhammad_sarwar: Do you not see that even if We give them respite for years
205.mohsin_khan: Tell Me, if We do let them enjoy for years,
205.arberry: What thinkest thou? If We give them enjoyment of days for many years,

206.sahih_international: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
206.pickthall: And then cometh that which they were promised,
206.yusuf_ali: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
206.shakir: Then there comes to them that with which they are threatened,
206.muhammad_sarwar: and then Our torment will strike them,
206.mohsin_khan: And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised!
206.arberry: then there comes on them that they were promised,

207.sahih_international: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
207.pickthall: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
207.yusuf_ali: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
207.shakir: That which they were made to enjoy shall not avail them?
207.muhammad_sarwar: none of their luxuries will be able to save them from the torment?
207.mohsin_khan: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.
207.arberry: what will it then avail them, the enjoyment of days they were given?

208.sahih_international: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
208.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
208.yusuf_ali: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
208.shakir: And We did not destroy any town but it had (its) warners,
208.muhammad_sarwar: We never destroyed any town without first sending to them warning and guidance.
208.mohsin_khan: And never did We destroy a township, but it had its warners
208.arberry: Never a city We destroyed, but it had warners

209.sahih_international: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
209.pickthall: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
209.yusuf_ali: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
209.shakir: To remind, and We are never unjust.
209.muhammad_sarwar: We have never been unjust to anyone.
209.mohsin_khan: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.
209.arberry: for a reminder; and never did We wrong.

210.sahih_international: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
210.pickthall: The devils did not bring it down.
210.yusuf_ali: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
210.shakir: And the Shaitans have not come down with it.
210.muhammad_sarwar: The satans have not revealed the Quran;
210.mohsin_khan: And it is not the Shayatin (devils) who have brought it (this Quran) down,
210.arberry: Not by the Satans has it been brought down;

211.sahih_international: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
211.pickthall: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
211.yusuf_ali: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
211.shakir: And it behoves them not, and they have not the power to do (it).
211.muhammad_sarwar: they are not supposed to do so. Nor do have they the ability for such a task.
211.mohsin_khan: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).
211.arberry: it behoves them not, neither are they able.

212.sahih_international: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
212.pickthall: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
212.yusuf_ali: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
212.shakir: Most surely they are far removed from the hearing of it.
212.muhammad_sarwar: The satans are barred from listening to anything from the heavens.
212.mohsin_khan: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.
212.arberry: Truly, they are expelled from hearing.

213.sahih_international: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
213.pickthall: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
213.yusuf_ali: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
213.shakir: So call not upon another god with Allah, lest you be of those who are punished.
213.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), do not worship anything besides God lest you suffer the punishment.
213.mohsin_khan: So invoke not with Allah another ilah (god) lest you be among those who receive punishment.
213.arberry: So call thou not upon another god with God, lest thou shouldst be one of those that are chastised.

214.sahih_international: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
214.pickthall: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
214.mohsin_khan: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad SAW) of near kindred.
214.arberry: And warn thy clan, thy nearest kin.

215.sahih_international: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
215.pickthall: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
215.yusuf_ali: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
215.shakir: And be kind to him who follows you of the believers.
215.muhammad_sarwar: and be kind to your believing followers.
215.mohsin_khan: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.
215.arberry: Lower thy wing to those who follow thee, being believers;

216.sahih_international: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
216.pickthall: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
216.yusuf_ali: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
216.shakir: But if they disobey you, then say: Surely I am clear of what you do.
216.muhammad_sarwar: If they disobey you, tell them, "I condemn your disobedient deeds".
216.mohsin_khan: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."
216.arberry: then, if they disobey thee, say, 'I am quit of that you do.'

217.sahih_international: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
217.pickthall: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
217.yusuf_ali: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
217.shakir: And rely on the Mighty, the Merciful,
217.muhammad_sarwar: Have trust in the Majestic and All-merciful God,
217.mohsin_khan: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,
217.arberry: Put thy trust in the All-mighty, the All-compassionate

218.sahih_international: Who sees you when you arise
218.pickthall: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
218.yusuf_ali: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
218.shakir: Who sees you when you stand up.
218.muhammad_sarwar: who can see whether you stand up
218.mohsin_khan: Who sees you (O Muhammad SAW) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).
218.arberry: who sees thee when thou standest

219.sahih_international: And your movement among those who prostrate.
219.pickthall: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
219.yusuf_ali: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
219.shakir: And your turning over and over among those who prostrate themselves before Allah.
219.muhammad_sarwar: or move during your prostration with the worshippers.
219.mohsin_khan: And your movements among those who fall prostrate (along with you to Allah in the five compulsory congregational prayers).
219.arberry: and when thou turnest about among those who bow.

220.sahih_international: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
220.pickthall: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
220.yusuf_ali: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
220.shakir: Surely He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
220.mohsin_khan: Verily! He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
220.arberry: Surely He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

221.sahih_international: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
221.pickthall: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
221.yusuf_ali: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
221.shakir: Shall I inform you (of him) upon whom the Shaitans descend?
221.muhammad_sarwar: Should I tell you to whom the satans come?
221.mohsin_khan: Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayatin (devils) descend?
221.arberry: Shall I tell you on whom the Satans come down?

222.sahih_international: They descend upon every sinful liar.
222.pickthall: They descend on every sinful, false one.
222.yusuf_ali: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
222.shakir: They descend upon every lying, sinful one,
222.muhammad_sarwar: They come to every sinful liar.
222.mohsin_khan: They descend on every lying (one who tells lies), sinful person.
222.arberry: They come down on every guilty impostor.

223.sahih_international: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
223.pickthall: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
223.yusuf_ali: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
223.shakir: They incline their ears, and most of them are liars.
223.muhammad_sarwar: The satans try to listen to the heavens but many of them are liars.
223.mohsin_khan: Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.
223.arberry: They give ear, but most of them are liars.

224.sahih_international: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
224.pickthall: As for poets, the erring follow them.
224.yusuf_ali: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
224.shakir: And as to the poets, those who go astray follow them.
224.muhammad_sarwar: Only the erring people follow the poets.
224.mohsin_khan: As for the poets, the erring follow them,
224.arberry: And the poets -- the perverse follow them;

225.sahih_international: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
225.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
225.yusuf_ali: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
225.shakir: Do you not see that they wander about bewildered in every valley?
225.muhammad_sarwar: Have you not seen them wandering and bewildered in every valley
225.mohsin_khan: See you not that they speak about every subject (praising others right or wrong) in their poetry?
225.arberry: hast thou not seen how they wander in every valley

226.sahih_international: And that they say what they do not do? -
226.pickthall: And how they say that which they do not?
226.yusuf_ali: And that they say what they practise not?-
226.shakir: And that they say that which they do not do,
226.muhammad_sarwar: and preaching what they themselves never practice.
226.mohsin_khan: And that they say what they do not do.
226.arberry: and how they say that which they do not?

227.sahih_international: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
227.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
227.yusuf_ali: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
227.shakir: Except those who believe and do good and remember Allah much, and defend themselves after they are oppressed; and they who act unjustly shall know to what final place of turning they shall turn back.
227.muhammad_sarwar: The righteously striving believers among them who remember God very often and use their talent to seek help after they have been wronged are the exceptional. The unjust will soon know how terrible their end will be.
227.mohsin_khan: Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism), and do righteous deeds, and remember Allah much, and reply back (in poetry) to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims). And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.
227.arberry: Save those that believe, and do righteous deeds, and remember God oft, and help themselves after being wronged; and those who do wrong shall surely know by what overturning they will he overturned.
